verdict.rationale: Fivetran docs claim connectors handle 'incremental syncs automatically' and support manual re-sync at connection/table level, implying resilient sync behavior, but there is no explicit documentation of automatic retry-on-transient-failure or checkpoint-based resume logic. Community evidence directly undercuts the claim: users report syncs 'getting out of sync' every couple of months requiring a full re-sync rather than resuming from a checkpoint (fivetran-comm-13), and others cite unreliable APIs failing randomly (fivetran-comm-6). Missing for 10: explicit docs describing retry/backoff mechanisms and checkpoint-based resume, and hands-on confirmation that interrupted syncs resume rather than restart.
